The successor of a natural number `n`.

Using `Nat.succ n` should usually be avoided in favor of `n + 1`, which is the [simp normal
form](https://lean-lang.org/doc/reference/4.26.0/find/?domain=Verso.Genre.Manual.section&name=simp-normal-forms).
name: Nat.succ

  | succ (n : Nat) : Nat
